info.title: glider-trace
info.description: Runtime evidence MCP server for C#/.NET agents. Supports stdio and HTTP transports.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Runtime evidence MCP server for C#/.NET agents (stdio or HTTP).
Requires .NET 10 SDK.

options.name: --workspace
options.description:
Trusted workspace root for trace operations (default: current
directory). Repeatable: the first is the primary root (relative-path
anchor and default artifact location), each later one adds a root.

options.name: --allow-executable
options.description:
Enable an executable policy beyond the default dotnet-only command
allowlist. Repeatable. Policies: msbuild (Visual Studio MSBuild.exe
via vswhere), nuget-workspace (a workspace-local .nuget\NuGet.exe),
vstest (vstest.console.exe from Visual Studio or restored packages).

options.name: --default-timeout
options.description:
Default timeout for async tools (default: 20m). Use 0 to disable.
Supported units: ms, s, m (for example: 10ms, 10s, 10m).
--allow-runtime-workspaces Allow the trace_add_workspace tool to register additional trusted
workspace roots at runtime (default: off). Runtime roots are not
persisted across restarts.

options.name: --no-telemetry
options.description: Disable anonymous usage telemetry (also honors DO_NOT_TRACK).
